title: User Manuals
text: User Manuals Step-by-step visual guides for each portal and app of the FlowerShop IoT Platform. Each manual is a self-contained HTML file with embedded screenshots — open it directly in any browser, no internet connection required. Portal & App Manuals 🛡️ Admin Portal Manual Complete guide for platform administrators — manage vendors & approvals, subscriptions, vase orders, asset-recovery incidents, customers, orders and payments at admin.findmyflowers.pl 🌹 Vendor Portal Manual Complete guide for flower shop owners and freelance florists — self sign-up, dashboard, bouquets, live vase status, vase ordering, orders, stock, payments, analytics, billing and settings at vendors.findmyflowers.pl 📱 Vendor Mobile App Manual Guide to the FindMyFlowers Business Android app — sign-up, photographing and pricing bouquets at the vase, QR scanning, vase status, orders, alerts, stock and the AI Florist 📘 Customer App Manual Complete guide for customers — discover bouquets on the map, manage your cart, place orders and track deliveries at app.findmyflowers.pl Coverage Manual Screenshots Sections Theme Admin Portal 23 pages Authentication, Dashboard, Vendor Mgmt, Vase Mgmt, Customer Mgmt, Orders, Payments, Subscriptions, Vendor Approval, Vase Order Fulfillment, Asset Recovery Blue Vendor Portal 30 pages Authentication, Self Sign-Up, Dashboard, Bouquets, Smart Vases (online / offline), Vase Ordering, Orders, Stock, Payments, Feedback, Analytics, Settings, Billing, Support Green Vendor Mobile App 49 screens Getting Started, Native Sign-Up, Home, Smart Vases & QR, Bouquets & Map, Orders, Alerts, Stock, AI Florist, Business Settings, Vase Ordering, Insights, Billing Green Customer App 11 pages Browse Bouquets, Authentication, Shopping, Orders, Account Teal Sections in bold for the Admin Portal cover the EP-19–22 features (vendor self-registration, SaaS platform subscription, smart-vase hardware ordering, and asset-recovery incidents); for the vendor manuals they mark the newest features (EP-28 AI Florist, EP-30 / EP-M11 stock management, native mobile sign-up). The vendor manuals are generated from scripts/manuals/*.json with python scripts/manuals/build_manual.py <spec.json>; screenshots live in docs/manuals/screenshots/vendor and vendor-mobile.

title: Home
text: FlowerShop IoT Platform Multi-tenant SaaS platform connecting flower vendors with customers through IoT-enabled smart vases. Use the left panel to navigate all documentation sections. v1.2.0 Released October 21, 2026 · Changelog User Manuals 🌹 Vendor Portal Manual Running your shop on the web: bouquets, smart vases, orders, stock, AI Florist, billing 📱 Vendor Mobile App Manual The FindMyFlowers Business app: photos at the vase, QR, orders, alerts, stock 📘 Customer App Manual Find bouquets on the map, order, pay and track your delivery 🛡️ Admin Portal Manual Platform administration Architecture 🏗️ Overview Tech stack, Clean Architecture layers, key patterns 🌐 C4 Context System-level view: users and external systems 📦 C4 Containers All runtime containers and their communication 🔩 C4 Components API layer internals: controllers → handlers → domain 🗂️ Domain Model ER diagram of all 14 aggregates ⚙️ Cross-cutting Middleware, caching, multi-tenancy, idempotency Flows 🔐 Authentication Keycloak OIDC, dev-token, tenant resolution, token blacklist 🛍️ Customer Browse, QR scan, cart, order, payment, delivery 🌹 Vendor Onboarding, bouquet lifecycle, order fulfillment 🛡️ Admin Vendor approval, suspension, analytics 📡 IoT Vase registration, MQTT, heartbeat, sensor data 💳 Payments Stripe checkout, webhook, outbox, confirmation ⚡ Real-time SignalR hub groups, outbox dispatch, view counter API & Contracts 📋 Mobile API Contracts Full REST + SignalR contract for the mobile app 📤 Outbound Contracts Domain events and integration event schemas Deployment 🚀 Overview Hosting topology, infrastructure providers 📐 Deployment Spec Component placement rationale and required code changes 📗 Runbook Ordered deploy-day steps with health-check gates 🔭 Observability Logs, health endpoints, metrics, alerting
